<!-- PR title: [Type] scope: title, or [Type] [Hardware] scope: title.
Type: Feat, Fix, Refactor, Perf, Doc, Test, CI, or Chore.
Scope: any module or model name (no fixed list or letter-case restriction), e.g. attention, qwen3, or flash-attn.
Hardware: optional single tag without spaces. Use uppercase hardware tags (AMD, NVIDIA, NPU, MI300X), except for exactly these four spellings: Intel, Apple, Huawei, Ascend.
Title: no letter-case restriction.
Reverts: use GitHub's default title, Revert "original title".
Examples: [Fix] attention: Fix KV cache indexing; [Perf] [AMD] flash-attn: Optimize decode performance. -->

## Motivation

Out-of-tree (OOT) platforms cannot run EAGLE-family speculative decoding today, including NEXTN/MTP drafts:

- The built-in `EAGLEWorkerV2` keeps its bookkeeping in device tensors with data-dependent shapes. Platforms that compile a graph per shape cannot run it efficiently, so they ship their own speculative worker (for example one that keeps the bookkeeping on the host) and today have to monkeypatch `SpeculativeAlgorithm.create_worker` to install it.
- On an OOT device the built-in path is broken without saying so: `verify_tree_greedy_func` has no branch for it and returns its inputs unfilled, and `build_tree_kernel_efficient` calls a kernel that is only imported on CUDA/HIP/MUSA builds.

This PR is the first step of generic OOT speculative-decoding support. It adds the platform worker factory and makes the unsupported built-in path fail loudly. Follow-ups will add the seams the built-in worker needs on an OOT device (draft attention backend registry, draft graph runners, spec kernels on `BaseFusedOp` with native fallbacks).

## Modifications

- `SRTPlatform.get_speculative_worker_cls(algorithm)` (default `None`). On an OOT platform `create_worker` returns this class for any algorithm; `None` keeps the built-in worker. The class is constructed with the built-in worker's keyword arguments and must reject flags it cannot serve. `SpeculativeAlgorithm.get_platform_worker_cls()` is the single lookup.
- EAGLE / EAGLE3 / NEXTN / STANDALONE on an OOT platform now require `supports_speculative_algorithm(algorithm)` (NEXTN is asked as `"EAGLE"`), mirroring the existing DFLASH gate, with an actionable error.
- `adaptive_unsupported_reason()` reports a platform worker, so `--speculative-adaptive` falls back to static parameters with the existing warning instead of being silently ignored (`AdaptiveController` lives only in `EAGLEWorkerV2`).
- `build_tree_kernel_efficient` and `verify_tree_greedy_func` raise `NotImplementedError` via `reject_out_of_tree_path` on an OOT device that has no tree kernel. In-tree devices and OOT platforms on a CUDA/HIP/MUSA torch build are unchanged.
- Docs: the hook is added to the plugin guide.

**Behavior change for OOT platforms:** EAGLE-family algorithms now need `supports_speculative_algorithm(...)` to return True (default False, same as DFLASH). Built-in platforms are unaffected.

## Accuracy Tests

No change on built-in platforms: every new branch is guarded by `is_out_of_tree()` or sits on a path that previously raised or computed nothing.

## Tests

`test/registered/unit/spec/test_oot_eagle_hooks.py` (CPU, `base-a-test-cpu`):

- worker selection: the platform class wins on OOT, the built-in worker when the platform declines, in-tree platforms never consult the hook;
- algorithm gate: an unsupported OOT platform is rejected, built-in platforms are not gated;
- adaptive falls back with a platform worker and stays available with the built-in one;
- tree construction and greedy verification raise on an OOT device without a tree kernel (both fail on the pre-fix code), and the in-tree fall-through is unchanged.

```
pytest test/registered/unit/spec/ test/registered/unit/platforms/ \
       test/registered/unit/test_split_attention_backend_decisions.py
# 395 passed, 2 skipped
```

- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [ ] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

+import contextlib
+import sys
+import types
+import unittest
+from unittest.mock import Mock, patch, sentinel
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook import _check_oot_speculative_algorithm
+from sglang.srt.platforms.interface import SRTPlatform
+from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
+from sglang.srt.speculative import eagle_utils
+from sglang.srt.speculative.adaptive_spec_params import adaptive_unsupported_reason
+from sglang.srt.speculative.spec_info import SpeculativeAlgorithm
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=2, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+HOOK_MODULE = "sglang.srt.arg_groups.speculative_hook"
+WORKER_MODULE = "sglang.srt.speculative.eagle_worker_v2"
+DEVICE_FLAGS = ("_is_cuda", "_is_hip", "_is_musa", "_is_cpu", "_is_npu", "_is_xpu")
+
+
+class _PlatformWorker:
+    pass
+
+
+def _platform(
+    *, out_of_tree: bool = True, supported: bool = True, worker_cls=None
+) -> Mock:
+    platform = Mock(spec=SRTPlatform)
+    platform.device_name = "custom"
+    platform.is_out_of_tree.return_value = out_of_tree
+    platform.supports_speculative_algorithm.return_value = supported
+    platform.get_speculative_worker_cls.return_value = worker_cls
+    return platform
+
+
+class TestOOTEagleWorkerSelection(CustomTestCase):
+    def _create_worker(self, platform: Mock):
+        args = ServerArgs(model_path="dummy", device="custom")
+        builtin = types.ModuleType(WORKER_MODULE)
+        builtin.EAGLEWorkerV2 = sentinel.builtin_worker
+        with (
+            patch("sglang.srt.platforms.current_platform", platform),
+            patch.dict(sys.modules, {WORKER_MODULE: builtin}),
+        ):
+            return SpeculativeAlgorithm.EAGLE.create_worker(args)
+
+    def test_platform_worker_replaces_builtin(self):
+        platform = _platform(worker_cls=sentinel.platform_worker)
+        self.assertIs(self._create_worker(platform), sentinel.platform_worker)
+        platform.get_speculative_worker_cls.assert_called_once_with(algorithm="EAGLE")
+
+    def test_builtin_worker_when_platform_declines(self):
+        declining = _platform(worker_cls=None)
+        self.assertIs(self._create_worker(declining), sentinel.builtin_worker)
+        in_tree = _platform(out_of_tree=False, worker_cls=sentinel.platform_worker)
+        self.assertIs(self._create_worker(in_tree), sentinel.builtin_worker)
+        in_tree.get_speculative_worker_cls.assert_not_called()
+
+
+class TestOOTEagleAlgorithmGate(CustomTestCase):
+    def test_unsupported_out_of_tree_platform_is_rejected(self):
+        with patch(f"{HOOK_MODULE}.current_platform", _platform(supported=False)):
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "EAGLE speculative decoding"):
+                _check_oot_speculative_algorithm(algorithm="EAGLE", device="custom")
+
+    def test_builtin_platforms_are_not_gated(self):
+        platform = _platform(out_of_tree=False, supported=False)
+        with patch(f"{HOOK_MODULE}.current_platform", platform):
+            _check_oot_speculative_algorithm(algorithm="EAGLE", device="cuda")
+        platform.supports_speculative_algorithm.assert_not_called()
+
+
+class TestOOTPlatformWorkerAdaptive(CustomTestCase):
+    def _reason(self, platform: Mock):
+        args = ServerArgs(
+            model_path="dummy", device="custom", speculative_algorithm="EAGLE"
+        )
+        with patch("sglang.srt.platforms.current_platform", platform):
+            return adaptive_unsupported_reason(args)
+
+    def test_platform_worker_disables_adaptive(self):
+        reason = self._reason(_platform(worker_cls=_PlatformWorker))
+        self.assertIn("_PlatformWorker", reason)
+
+    def test_builtin_worker_keeps_adaptive(self):
+        self.assertIsNone(self._reason(_platform(worker_cls=None)))
+        self.assertIsNone(
+            self._reason(_platform(out_of_tree=False, worker_cls=_PlatformWorker))
+        )
+
+
+class TestOOTEagleKernelDispatch(CustomTestCase):
+    """An OOT device has no tree kernel; it must fail loudly, not compute nothing."""
+
+    def _run(self, platform: Mock, fn):
+        with contextlib.ExitStack() as stack:
+            for flag in DEVICE_FLAGS:
+                stack.enter_context(patch.object(eagle_utils, flag, False))
+            stack.enter_context(patch.object(eagle_utils, "current_platform", platform))
+            return fn()
+
+    def _build_tree(self):
+        return eagle_utils.build_tree_kernel_efficient(
+            bonus_tokens=torch.tensor([5]),
+            parent_list=torch.zeros((1, 2), dtype=torch.long),
+            top_scores_index=torch.zeros((1, 2), dtype=torch.long),
+            draft_tokens=torch.tensor([[6, 7]]),
+            seq_lens=torch.tensor([4]),
+            seq_lens_sum=4,
+            topk=1,
+            spec_steps=2,
+            num_verify_tokens=3,
+            tree_mask_mode=eagle_utils.TreeMaskMode.QLEN_ONLY,
+        )
+
+    def _verify(self):
+        return eagle_utils.verify_tree_greedy_func(
+            predicts=None,
+            accept_index=None,
+            accept_token_num=None,
+            candidates=None,
+            retrieve_index=None,
+            retrieve_next_token=None,
+            retrieve_next_sibling=None,
+            target_predict=None,
+        )
+
+    def test_out_of_tree_device_is_rejected(self):
+        for name, fn in (("build_tree", self._build_tree), ("verify", self._verify)):
+            with self.subTest(op=name):
+                with self.assertRaisesRegex(NotImplementedError, "no platform seam"):
+                    self._run(_platform(), fn)
+
+    def test_in_tree_verify_fallthrough_is_unchanged(self):
+        self.assertEqual(
+            self._run(_platform(out_of_tree=False), self._verify), (None, None, None)
+        )
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
